custody_gaps: The exact API query strings used at ingest were not recorded for the three Eurostat files or the World Bank file. The `pointer` URLs are the canonical dataset pages (verified reachable 2026-09-03), not the recorded request; a re-fetch will return current data, not these bytes. The bytes themselves are the custody record, which is why they are redistributed in this repository.

No MediaWiki revid was recorded for these four Wikipedia files (the Stage-3 mountain manifest does carry revids). Only wikipedia-us.wiki's article title was recorded, in data/CONTRACT.md Addendum 2; the RU / IN / AT titles were not. Their `role` fields quote the contract's source notes and each file's own [[Category:]] links identify the article.
